title: China Rolls Out Rocket for Tiangong Mission
summary: China has rolled out the rocket and spacecraft for the Shenzhou-24 mission to carry the first international astronaut to the Tiangong space station.

title: Mitsubishi Electric Unveils AI and Humanoid Robot CNC Cell
summary: Mitsubishi Electric demonstrated a CNC work cell combining AI and a general-purpose humanoid robot at the Japan International Machine Tool Fair.

title: Thames Water Seeks Approval for £7bn Reservoir
summary: Thames Water has applied for a development consent order to build a massive new reservoir near Abingdon in Oxfordshire.

summary: PSE&G won the DTECH Northeast 2026 Grid Changer Award for its Electric Vehicle Charging Program.

title: Addressing Thermal and EMI in GaN Converters
summary: Engineers must treat switching behavior, EMI, PCB design, and thermal management as interconnected challenges in GaN power converters.

title: Human Liver Kept Alive Outside Body for Seven Weeks
summary: Australian researchers successfully kept a donated human liver alive on life support outside the body for a record seven weeks.

title: UK Construction Records 25 Workplace Deaths
summary: Provisional Health and Safety Executive figures show the construction sector recorded 25 workplace fatalities in 2025/26.

title: Materialise Urges Coordinated AM Network for Defense
summary: Materialise called for shared standards, qualification frameworks, and secure digital infrastructure to link production resources across borders.

title: U.S. Gas Turbine Fleet Upgrades Could Add 600 TWh
summary: An analysis previews that the existing U.S. gas turbine fleet could add up to 600 TWh annually through maintenance and upgrades.

title: ICE Urges Greater Public Say Over Infrastructure
summary: The Institution of Civil Engineers and the Future Governance Forum urged leaders to give communities more say over infrastructure projects.

title: Italian Startup GR1T Unveils Modular Electric Motorcycle
summary: Startup GR1T introduced a single platform serving as the foundation for four distinct electric motorcycles sharing the same components.

title: McCrory Nears Completion of First Rail Project
summary: Stockport-based contractor McCrory is nearing completion on its first rail project while targeting sector growth.

title: Simulating Plasma Chambers for Semiconductor Manufacturing
summary: Researchers linked plasma chamber simulation with feature-scale process modeling to optimize plasma etching processes and predict etch profiles.

summary: Multiple designs are emerging for CPO and NPO, though standardization and high-volume manufacturing remain unready.

summary: ST expects to double its microcontroller revenues between 2005 and 2028, according to group president Remi El-Ouazzane.

summary: The deal adds specialized silicon expertise to AMD's accelerator roadmap and expands its engineering presence in Canada.

title: New Guide for NEC4 Engineering Contracts
summary: A new book provides practical solutions and step-by-step guidance for professionals administering NEC4 engineering and construction contracts.

title: Probing Action-Dependent Semantic Forecasting in Autonomous Driving
